//: The pinned Node runtime that goes into the bundle (spec §28.4), per target. Deliberately the official nodejs.org build and not the build machine's own: a nix-built node carries its ELF interpreter as a /nix/store path, so a .deb shipping one would run on the build box and nowhere else. Checksums are from nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt for this version, pinned here so the download is verified against the repo rather than against the server it came from.
